example.title: Brown's Creek Tributary Masonry Arch Bridge
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Brown's Creek Tributary Masonry Arch Bridge)

brief: Three-span WPA stone arch bridge-culvert on a gravel county road, each arch 12 ft, built of local Post Rock limestone in an ashlar pattern mixing rusticated and smooth faces; the walls rise three courses above the roadway as the rails, wing walls splay at 45 degrees and stair-step down, and a date stone in the north rail names the county and the WPA. Tree-lined creek in pasture and cropland.

traits.railing_detail: walls three courses above the road as rails
traits.masonry: Post Rock limestone ashlar, rusticated and smooth
traits.year_note: WPA era, exact year not given
